lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular clusters of high-luminance pixels arranged in multiple horizontal rows, with increased spacing and diameter in the posterior-mid flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high (dorsal) to low (ventral) creating a shadow effect.
